title: JBT Marel's EVi wins Innovation in Processing at the IceFish Awards
summary: We are proud to share that EVi, our intelligent, fully automated salmon gutting machine, has won the Innovation in Processing award at the 2026 IceFish Awards.
body_markdown:
It's a huge honor, and one that reflects something bigger than a single product: it shows that EVi is bringing real innovation to salmon gutting, a part of the value chain that hasn't seen meaningful advancement in many years.


##### Redefining salmon gutting


EVi is built to set new standards in efficiency, quality, and uptime. Powered by AQi vision technology, it automatically measures each fish, detects key anatomical features, performs precision cutting and viscera removal, and inspects gutting results for defects, all in real time and fish by fish.


Its dual-lane design is what sets it apart. Rather than simply increasing speed, the dual lanes enable a more thorough evisceration process without compromising throughput, while also providing built-in redundancy so production can continue even if one lane stops. Combined with a hygienic, open design that gives full 360° access to tools and hygiene-sensitive zones, EVi delivers consistent performance, maximum uptime, and a platform built for future-ready automation.


By detecting the anatomy of each individual fish, EVi enables fish-specific processing, something the market hasn't had before at this scale, while reducing waste by preventing incorrect processing and safeguarding raw material. And because the platform is built on state-of-the-art sensing and control technology, it can keep learning and improving over time, becoming more accurate and adaptable with less dependency on user input.


##### Proven in the field


EVi's impact is already showing up on processing floors.[Bakkafrost](https://jbtmarel.com/en/news/bakkafrost-backs-jbt-marel-innovation-with-purchase-agreement-of-first-evi-salmon-gutting-machine/) in the Faroe Islands became the first company to invest in EVi, integrating it into their production line with promising results from ongoing testing and operation. In Norway,[Åstafjord Slakteri](https://jbtmarel.com/en/news/astafjord-slakteri-invests-in-groundbreaking-salmon-gutting-technology-from-jbt-marel/) became the first in the country to adopt the technology after visiting Bakkafrost's facility to see it in action, reporting that its performance exceeded all expectations. Last month,[Salaks](https://jbtmarel.com/en/news/salaks-orders-two-jbt-marel-evi-gutting-machines-for-high-capacity-high-quality-processing/) ordered two EVi machines for their harvesting facility in Rotvika, Norway, to support their production growth with capacity and quality together. Together, these commitments show that EVi isn't just a concept, it's revolutionizing how the salmon industry approaches gutting.
